question_text: A 26-year-old woman presents to the clinic with complaints of missing her 'monthlies'. She usually has her menses are around the 15th of every month and they last for about 4 days. She is not on any birth control and has recently gotten into a relationship with a boy from college. She is on lithium for maintenance therapy of her bipolar disorder. She once took herself off of lithium, but she became so depressed that she had a suicide attempt shortly after. She is concerned about how lithium use might affect her fetus if she were pregnant.  What is the single most appropriate recommendation?
